adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed rework recovered primary-text antifungal and fungicidal activity rows, adjudicated linked database conflicts without hiding modification gaps, and downgraded mechanism claims to phenotype-level evidence. The paper is publication-grade with explicit cautions, not clean acceptance.
summary: Accepted with cautions after worker-2/4/6 source-reviewed rework; activity rows are source-locator-backed and database conflicts remain visible.

source_review_depth.notes: No supplementary assets exist for this paper in local source/packet inventory; XML, PDF text, OA package members, figure captions/images, and linked database rows were reopened.

materials_exhausted.note: Local source materials are exhausted for the targeted worker-2/4/6 repair. Full plotted curve point digitization is recorded as a nonblocking gap; exact values asserted in final rows are text-supported.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Linked database rows were rechecked against primary source peptide names/sequences, assay text, database JSONL rows, and merged sequence catalog. Residue/value support is recorded, but C-terminal amidation omissions and mixed external target rows remain cautions/source_conflicts.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Primary Results text and PDF text support 28 activity/fungicidal records with raw values, units, target species/strains, assay conditions, and locators. Mammalian toxicity is not reported in this paper and is not fabricated.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: The paper supports antifungal/fungicidal phenotype but explicitly leaves direct mode of action unresolved; mechanism is classified as phenotype/context only.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary paper names all KW/RW peptides as C-terminal amides; linked database residue strings generally omit that modification, so affected records are not promoted to exact source_verified identity.
Primary paper reports KW2/RW2 did not inhibit F. solani or F. oxysporum at 64 uM; generic database antifungal labels for RW2 are preserved as source_conflict.
dbAMP rows contain additional non-Fusarium target values tied to multiple references; only Fusarium values supported by this primary paper are used for this paper.
Exact full dose-response curve points from Figure 2/Figure 4 are not text-resolved; final rows use only exact values stated in XML/PDF text.
The local primary paper reports fungal growth/viability assays, not mammalian hemolysis or cytotoxicity assays.
Mechanism is not promoted beyond phenotype-level antifungal/fungicidal activity.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Primary XML/PDF text provides MIC/no-inhibition, two sub-MIC inhibition percentages, and MTT killing percentages, but not every plotted dose-response point from Figure 2 or Figure 4 as machine-readable text. The chart images are available locally, but exact curve-point extraction would require unsupported visual digitization and is not needed to resolve the blocking missing-activity-row ticket.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Nonblocking for publication-grade re-review because all exact values asserted in the final activity rows are source-supported and no unextracted plotted point is used to adjudicate a database row.

publication_grade_rationale: All strict gate hard blockers are resolved with source-locator-backed activity rows and no open rework targets; remaining issues are explicit nonblocking cautions.
